book.name: ACTS
book.title: In o Oꞌohanas g Haꞌichu hab ha-Juni g Jesus Chuhchai

content: Natsh am haha wo oidad g Tutuligo himdag hegam mo ab ihm g Jesus?

Kutsh am haꞌi dada Antiok t ab ab Judea t amjed k hab chum ha ahg hegam matsh ab i s‑wohoch g haꞌichu ha‑ahga ab amjed g Jesus, “Jiosh o am t‑chehani Mosesbad oꞌohana ed mat g chechoj hemho wa wo e oꞌoha an e pahl hikuchk. Kumt pi wo shaꞌi e doꞌibia mamtp pi hab wo e juh.”

Tsh wabshaba g Paul ch Barnabas pi shaꞌi hohhoꞌi ihda k am si ha neꞌowi idam Judea t am Tutuligo. Tsh am hahawa i e apꞌech matsh g Paul ch Barnabas am wo hihi Jerusalem wui haꞌi ep ha wehm k am wo s‑mai mat has wo chei hegam haꞌi ehp Jesus chuhchai ch geꞌeged.

Tsh idam am hihim k am i ha ahgidahi hegam mash ab ihm g Jesus Phenicia jewed oidk ch Samaria jewed oidk mat g gawul mahs hemajkam ab i e nodagi Jesus wui. Kutsh wehsijj ab si s‑ap i e tahtam k si s‑hehgig idam mash hedai i kah.

Kutsh ged hu dada Jerusalem t am. Tsh si s‑ha hoꞌigeꞌel g Jesus chuhchai ch geꞌeged ch wehsijj hegam mash ab ihm g Jesus amai. Tsh am hahawa ha ahgi mat haschu k ab am si i ha wehmt g Jiosh mat am hab juh.

Tsh wabshaba am haꞌi ab ha wui gegokiwua hegam mash si s‑gewkam oid g chehanig ch hab kaij, “Hemho wa at wo e oꞌoha an e pahl hikuchk g chechoj k am hab wo junihid hegai t‑chehanig mo g Jiosh ab t‑mahkch.”
Tsh am ep e nam g Jesus chuhchai ch geꞌeged k tash am aꞌaga ihda.

Tsh g Peter am i kekiwua k hab kaij: “Ni‑wepnag, s‑mahch am mant ga hu i wehpeg am ha ahgi g gawul mahs hemajkam g s‑kehg haꞌichu ahgaj g Jiosh ab amjed g Jesus nat pi g Jiosh am i ni‑gawulkai mant hab wo juh.
Jiosh o s‑mahch g oꞌodham chegitoi ch ab ep ha mah g Hekia S‑apꞌekam Gewkdag hab wa masma mat ahchim hab t‑juh.
Kuch heg hekaj s‑mahch mo s‑ha hoꞌigeꞌelid ch gam hu hab i juh g pi ap ha‑chuꞌijig mat ab i s‑wohoch g haꞌichu ahgaj.

Pegih, m haschu ahgch haꞌi piꞌichud g Jiosh ab s‑wehch haꞌichu ha mohtoꞌidch g wechij wohochuddam? Ahchim Tutuligo att pi shaꞌi t‑nako machs wehs am hab wo junihid g t‑chehanig. T g t‑shohshon hab waꞌap pi shaꞌi e nako.

Pi attki hab masma wo t‑doꞌibia. Heg at wo waꞌi t‑doꞌibia t‑kownalig Jesus. Ab att i s‑wohoch g haꞌichu ahgaj. T heg ab i s‑t‑hoꞌigeꞌid k t‑doꞌibia. Pegih, t hab waꞌi masma wo e doꞌibia idam gawul mahs hemajkam.” Neh, bash kaij g Peter.
Sh am hahawa ha ahgid g Barnabas ch Paul mat haschu s‑hasigam hab juh g Jiosh gewkdagkaj am ha shahgid g gawul mahs hemajkam. Kush wehsijj ab wabsh i pi shahmuni ch am ha kaiham.
Tsh am i haꞌasa neneo. Tsh g James am i kuhgi g ha‑ahga mash hab kaij, “Ni‑wepnag, ab g wo i ni‑kaiham.
Peter o am t‑ahgid matsh has masma g Jiosh am chehgi mo pihk e elid ha hekaj g nahnko mahs hemajkam ch am haꞌi i ha gawulkai mat d wo hemajkamgajk.
K id am wohokamchud mat wa has i masma an oꞌoha g kekelibad Jiosh haꞌichu i tashogiddam mash wa hab kaij g Jiosh:

content.text: ‘Neh, e at padch g Davidbad kownaltalig.
K wabshaba ab him g tash mant am ep wo i apꞌechud k am hema wo i kei g amjedkam am kehkud ed mant heg gahi wuhshanim wo i himch g kownaltalig.
T g nahnko mahs hemajkam ab wo i ni‑gahghi.
Hegam ani ab i ha waid mat d wo ni‑hemajkamgak.’
Neh, bo kaij g Jiosh ch heg am i t‑tashogid heki hu waꞌi amjed. Amos 9:11-12

content: “Kuni hab ep s‑cheꞌimk mani hab hi elid matt pi ab hu wo ha mohtoꞌi g t‑chehanigkaj hegam gawul mahs hemajkam mat ab i e nohnogi Jiosh wui.

Tt hi wabsh wo ha ahgi mat has wo e junihid. T hab ab ha wui wo si s‑ap e tahtkkad hegam t‑wehm oꞌodham mo am ha wehm kihdag. Tt wabsh wo ha cheha mat wo si e nuhkud g hejel e‑wehm kihkam wehhejed ch pi ab hu wo ihm hab masma mo d Jiosh hegai mo pi d Jiosh haꞌichu koꞌadch mo ab e toꞌid ha wui k pi wo koꞌad g ehꞌed ch hegai mo pi gam hu e iawua g ehꞌed e mumꞌajch.
Id o wehsko si s‑ap s‑e mahch no pi an ahgachug wehs kihhim ch ed ch am e neꞌokchulid t‑wehm oꞌodham ha‑chechopi ed.”
Mamtsh haschu i ha oꞌohani hegam gawul mahs hemajkam mo ab ihm g Jesus

Tsh idam Jesus chuhchai ch geꞌeged am i apꞌech am wehs ha wehm hegam mash ab ihm g Jesus amai matsh am haꞌi wo i ha chuhcha. Tsh idam am wo i ha oi g Paul ch Barnabas am Antiok wui. Sh idam d ha‑chuhchai Judas Barsabbas ch Silas nash pi g hemajkam ab si has ha elid.

Kutsh ab ha mah g oꞌohana matsh wo bek am Antiok wui. Sh hab chuꞌig ihda oꞌohana: “T‑naipijju mam d gawul mahs hemajkam ch ab ihm g Jesus ch ab kihdag Antiok t ab ch Syria t ab ch Cilicia t ab. B ach si em‑hoꞌigeꞌelid ahchim mach d Jesus chuhchai ch geꞌeged ia Jerusalem t ab.
“Idam Barnabas ch Paul o ab t‑ahgid mat am haꞌi hihi g t‑wehm oꞌodham k am em‑kudu am haꞌichu pi ap em‑ahgidk. Kuch eda wa chum pi shaꞌi ha apꞌechud mat hab wo e juh.
Kutt heg hekaj wehsijj ia t‑hemapad k am i apꞌech matt has wo t‑juh. B o si i s‑ap e dagitokch idam Barnabas ch Paul am chikpanaj ed g t‑kownalig Jesus Christ ch hekaj chum alo e koꞌij.
Kutt gohk ep i ha chuhcha mat am wo i ha oid k si s‑ap wo em‑ahgi mach haschu i em‑oꞌohanid. K d idam Judas ch Silas.

T am i t‑tashogi g Hekia S‑apꞌekam Gewkdag mattki pi ab hu wo i em‑mohtoꞌi g t‑chehanig ahchim Tutuligo k wabsh wo em‑ahgi ihda mamt am hab hi wo wa junihid. T hab wabsh si s‑ap wo e tahtkkad em‑wui hegam t‑wehm oꞌodham mo am em‑wehm kihdag.

Neh, pi amt wo koꞌad g ehꞌed ch hegai mo pi gam hu e iawua g ehꞌed e mumꞌajch ch pi wo koꞌad hegai mo ab e toꞌid mo haschu hab chum e elid mo d jiosh. Mt wo si e nuhkud g hejel e‑wehm kihkam wehhejed. Mamtp wo si e nuhkud id ab k am wo wa s‑apꞌek. T g Jiosh am wo wa em‑wehmajk.”
Kutsh am hahawa gam hu hihi idam Barnabas ch Paul ch Judas ch Silas k gam hu dada Antiok t am. Tsh am i e hemapai hegam mash ab ihm g Jesus. Kutsh am i ha mah g oꞌohana.
Tsh idam am neꞌokchulid k si s‑ap i e taht natsh pi heg hekaj ab si i e gewkemhu.
Kush g Judas ch Silas hab waꞌap d Jiosh haꞌichu i tashogiddam ch am dadkkahim heꞌes i tash ch muꞌi haꞌichukaj am i ha gewkemhu.
Kumtsh am hahawa s‑ap i ha dagito mat wo uhpam hihi.
[Tsh wabshaba g Silas hab i e ah mat wabsh ha wehm wo dakad.]
Sh g Paul ch Barnabas heꞌes i tash am dadkkahim Antiok t am am ha jehnigidch ab amjed g Jesus. Sh muꞌijj hab waꞌap ha ahgid g haꞌichu ahga ab amjed g Jesus.
Matsh ep wo i ha mihshmedo g Paul ch Barnabas k i e gawulkai
Sh am hu hebai amjed, sh hab kaij g Paul ab Barnabas wui, “Am att ep wo hihim k am wo i ha gewkemhu wehs kihhim ch ed mach wa hebai ahgachug g Jiosh haꞌichu ahga k am wo ha nei mas has waꞌi masma.”
Kush g Barnabas hab chum kaij mat wo bek g John Mark.
Tsh wabshaba g Paul pi hohhoꞌi mat wo bek nat pi wa am wabsh i ha dagito Pamphylia t am k pi am hu ha wehm i nahto g chikpan.
Kutsh id am si pi ha apꞌet. Tsh hekaj i e gawulkai. Kutsh g Barnabas bek g Mark k gan hu aigo i shul geꞌe wahlkokaj Cyprus jewed t am.
Tsh wabshaba g Paul g Silas am epai bek mat wo oi. Kumtsh am e hoꞌigeꞌidahun k am i ha dagito Jiosh hemajimatalig ed.
Tsh idam Paul am hihi Syria ch Cilicia jejewed oidk k am i ha gewkemhunahim hegam mash ab ihm g Jesus.
